nodes.label: Consumer SKU ladder: Free / Plus $19 / Pro $39 / Power $59 (+ broker B2B per-active-MAU); ship Free+Pro only at launch
nodes.rationale: WTP benchmarks (OptionStrat, Tradytics, TradingView's $15/$30/$60 ladder) support 4 tiers; blended paid ARPU target ~$28/mo on a 60/30/10 mix, but a 3-person team should build/gate only two states (free/paid) before the first dollar clears.

nodes.label: India pricing ₹399/₹799 (Razorpay/UPI) as funnel and dataset, explicitly excluded from ARR
nodes.rationale: A USD wall will not convert in India and profit promises to the 91%-loss cohort are legally barred; India volume feeds the dataset and the '350K beginners' acquirer narrative, undercutting Sensibull's ₹800 anchor.

nodes.label: Aha-gate paywall fired after the first paper trade, wired verbatim to the existing proFunnel() labels
nodes.rationale: proFunnel() already defines Visited /trade → Built a strategy → Opened paper trade → Hit pro paywall → Upgraded to Pro; walling after the aha (drag cone, probability ring, one AI narration, one paper trade) maximizes conversion, and reusing the labels lights up the admin cockpit the moment gating ships.

nodes.label: Card-required 7-day Pro trial on every wall hit; annual pushed as default
nodes.rationale: Card-required trials (~31% trial-start vs ~9% opt-in) are the single biggest lever in the stack; annual retains ~44% Y1 vs ~17% monthly. The 6-7% blended conversion target is flagged as a guess, not a forecast.

nodes.label: Single entitlement model: lib/billing/entitlements.ts getPlan(userId) behind dual PSPs (Stripe global / Razorpay India)
nodes.rationale: The app never knows which processor charged; every gate reads one source of truth, with plan/planTrialEnds/dailyExplainCount/paperTradeCount added to the Mongo user doc and session callback (next-auth.d.ts currently has no plan field — verified greenfield).
